name: Ki no Tomonori
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 33); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. early 10th century.

poems.title: The spring has come, and once again
poems.author: Ki no Tomonori
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 33
poems.text:
The spring has come, and once again
The sun shines in the sky;
So gently smile the heavens, that
It almost makes me cry,
When blossoms droop and die.
